svg.title: verd screens
svg.desc: Four frames of the verd TUI: the Problems list with filter chips, the filter modal with a tag picker, the split Problem view with tests and the selected test input, expected and output, and the Settings tab with a theme gallery.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
